## Design intent & interactions (manual)

- ~34 keyframes; 18 clip-path/`background-clip` (gradient text + shaped panels). One scroll listener. No canvas/rAF.
- Heaviest `<script>` count (12) — mostly per-section reveal/interaction glue.
